name: oih-bio-tools
description: Computational biology tools (AlphaFold 3, RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, PeSTo, BindCraft, fpocket, P2Rank, Vina-GPU, AutoDock-GPU, GNINA, DiffDock, GROMACS, ESM-2, Chemprop, DiscoTope 3, IgFold, FreeSASA). Each tool runs in its own prebuilt Docker container; model weights live on the host and are mounted into the containers.
